subject: Sounds like a track from Burnout Three, 3, III, Takedown!
author: SUFFUR
body:
The sound tracks are the same'ish, so like Burnout 3 Takedown, did I say it sounded like it, some of the tracks from Burnout 3, then it does? See simple, what bit did you not understand? The Track from 50 Shots, Burnout somehting, or toher, sounds like a Music Tracks from the game Burnout 3 Takedown, made by Criterion. I like it and yes, could be apart of my Burnout Music Collection, but it does sound similar to some of the music tracks from that Game Burnout 3 Takedown. subject: 50 Shots!
author: Xandu
body:
Nice find Sonic! I didn't even know about this band. 50 Shots is a Norwegian band from place not too far from my home town Bergen. Funny enough they had a gig in Bergen this week... too bad I didn't get to go.  The song called Burning Out could definitely be on the Burnout 3 Takedown soundtrack or any other Burnout game for that matter.

Drunk should have a look at the music video as it has some cool (not necessarily good) snowboarding and water-skiing in it from the surrounding areas of Bergen.

-- The Creator --
